ranked.headline: Graph neural networks extend molecular interaction and property prediction across targets
ranked.summary: Recent items pair graph embeddings and fingerprint fusion with compound, protein, and drug-combination prediction tasks across diverse endpoints.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models score noncoding and rare variants for functional prioritization
ranked.summary: Learned models now score regulatory activity and variant effects directly from sequence, feeding rare-variant and noncoding prioritization.

ranked.headline: Learned models decode neural interactions across EEG, SEEG, ECoG and connectomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a shared-space ECoG study extend neural decoding toward subject alignment and model-brain correspondence.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map and denoise single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark imputation, deconvolution, and cross-modal mapping tools across scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics platforms.

ranked.headline: Plasmid and variant mining links mobile genetic content to hosts and function
ranked.summary: Late-2025 items pair plasmid and genome inventories with benchmarks or ecological context, such as soil plasmidomes and Hi-C host linkage.

ranked.headline: Learned noise and interaction structure from sparse high-dimensional biological data
ranked.summary: Sparse, noisy omics and time-series data now support Bayesian, copula, and graphical models that infer interaction and dynamic network structure directly.

ranked.headline: Sampling frame and marker choice decide which microbial lineages enter genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent studies show primers, public metadata, and sampling design fix which lineages are observed before any downstream inference begins.

ranked.headline: Transport and graph constraints on encoders for perturbation and spatial prediction
ranked.summary: Unpaired and partially measured single-cell and spatial datasets are driving models that combine learned encoders with transport or graph structure.

ranked.headline: Omitted epistasis inflates GWAS nulls; multitrait and metabolite maps extend loci
ranked.summary: Misspecified null models and large multi-trait and metabolite atlases now shape how association statistics are read as causal claims.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based models predict protein interactions, RNA structure and binding affinity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair protein language model embeddings with graph and attention architectures to predict interactions and assess structural reliability.

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD acceleration of alignment, simulation and metagenomic sequence workflows
ranked.summary: Throughput-focused sequence tools are appearing as standalone, containerized or hardware-accelerated software for large microbial and metagenomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Temporally resolved single-cell data fitted to dynamic models infer cell fate behavior
ranked.summary: Coupling temporally resolved single-cell measurements with kinetic and probabilistic models now enables dynamic inference beyond descriptive embeddings.

ranked.headline: Gapless T2T and population-scale reference genomes anchor baseline genomic resources
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release gapless T2T assemblies and population-scale multiomic reference datasets for downstream analysis.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic metabolic models infer disease-specific states across cancer and IBD
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair genome-scale models and multi-omic data to infer metabolic states in cancer, Crohn's disease, and the gut microbiome.

ranked.headline: Deep models on structured inputs predict epidemiological and molecular interactions
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 papers pair mobility graphs, protein language model embeddings and contrastive multi-view learning for site and binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for Y-haplogroup calling, Z-DNA prediction, LD mapping and assembly QC
ranked.summary: Four reusable tools and resources now make Y-haplogroup calling, Z-DNA prediction, LD mapping and assembly assessment directly applicable.

ranked.headline: Open-source packages make spatial, single-cell and multi-omics analyses reproducible
ranked.summary: Bioconductor and R-based tools now standardize preprocessing, visualization and multi-omics integration into documented, testable workflows.

ranked.headline: DNA sequence and nucleosome organization shape chromatin structure and accessibility
ranked.summary: Mechanistic chromatin models and sequence-based predictors now span scales from single CpG sites to 108-nucleosome fibers.

ranked.headline: Epidemic simulators pair RL reward design and ABC calibration for transmission modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published Python package extend epidemic simulation toward calibrated, spatially resolved, and behaviorally informed modeling.

ranked.headline: Language models condition protein and gene design on evolutionary and genomic context
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 reports extend learned sequence models from single-protein redesign to hybrid proteins and genome-scale functional design.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein binding, interaction, and allergenicity
ranked.summary: Sequence-only and structure-based models now target binding affinity, interfaces, and allergenicity, alongside scrutiny of AlphaFold 3 artifacts.

ranked.headline: Structure-based models link reaction network topology, parameters, and dynamical behavior
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend structure-based reaction network models to bifurcations, thermodynamic constraints, and kinetic fitting.

ranked.headline: Baseline-aware benchmarking of computational methods across omic data types
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test whether expression forecasting and single-cell proteomics workflows beat simple baselines on large perturbation datasets.

ranked.headline: Dimensionality, flexibility, and NMR-restrained sampling for macromolecular motions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend MD-derived analysis to coarse-grained, predicted, and AFM-derived ensemble inputs.

ranked.headline: Network-based gene and module prioritization gains causal and validation criteria
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply causal inference, graph learning, and standardized pipelines to rank network-derived disease genes and modules.

ranked.headline: Hybrid mechanistic-ML tools and noise-aware inference for dynamical biological models
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and hybrid modelling packages now appear alongside noise-aware equation discovery methods for time-series biological data.

ranked.headline: DNA deep learning models predict 3D chromatin and cell type-specific gene expression
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and Hi-C encoders now yield cell type-specific predictions of gene expression and 3D chromatin architecture from DNA.

ranked.headline: Small-molecule binding and oligomer dynamics in disordered and allosteric proteins
ranked.summary: Simulation and NMR studies now resolve dynamic binding paths, oligomer interfaces, and allosteric states in disordered and regulatory proteins.

ranked.headline: Topological tests and higher-order complexes expose structure in brain networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply Hodge, Wasserstein, Mapper, and combinatorial-complex methods to brain network topology beyond pairwise connections.

ranked.headline: Open pipelines automate protein binder design, docking, and coarse-grained topologies
ranked.summary: Recent items describe open, modular pipelines that chain single-cell analysis, binder design, and molecular topology generation into end-to-end workflows.

ranked.headline: Target-conditioned diffusion and flow models generate 3D ligands and therapeutic peptides
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple generators to explicit pocket, lead, prior, or expert-feedback information within the design loop.

ranked.headline: Encoded decision rules in sequencing tools for RNA-protein and splicing analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints place explicit statistical and algorithmic criteria inside tool design for RNA-protein, splicing, and binding-specificity analyses.

ranked.headline: Multiscale models couple cancer cell mechanics, immune priming and membrane biophysics
ranked.summary: Physics-based and pharmacokinetic simulations are being applied to cancer vaccination, cell migration and prostate cancer membranes.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes reveal chromosome fusions, hybrid coupling, and WGD inference biases
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and population genomic datasets now test how fusions, hybrid coupling, and duplication histories shape animal genome divergence.

ranked.headline: Fitting learning rules and circuit architectures to behavior and spiking dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work treats the learning rule and circuit architecture themselves as fitted quantities, tested against human behavior and spiking simulations.

ranked.headline: Open-source LLM agents map natural language to genomic and kinetic biology resources
ranked.summary: Open-source models now run locally inside agentic pipelines, enabling query access to genomic annotations, cohort metadata, and kinetic model repositories.

ranked.headline: Scalable graph algorithms for phylogenetic networks and pangenome bubble detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints supply provable algorithms and metrics for non-tree genomic structures, including lateral gene transfer networks and cyclic pangenome graphs.

ranked.headline: Network size, delays and beat frequencies shape oscillatory synchronization dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model how delays, frequency allocation, and maximum entropy constraints govern transitions in neuronal network dynamics.

ranked.headline: Noise, dispersal, and nutrient limits reshape predator-prey population dynamics
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints quantify how noise, dispersal, nutrient co-limitation, and graph structure constrain population states.
